metadata.description: The Purely Personal AI C-Suite plugin · 5 engines (Marketing, Sales, Operations, Cash, Leadership) + 38 frameworks + BUSINESS-BRAIN.md as the context layer

plugins.name: purely-personal
plugins.description: An AI C-Suite for solopreneurs. 8 slash commands wired to BUSINESS-BRAIN.md and 38 operator-grade frameworks. Marketing, Sales, Operations, Cash, and Leadership engines that read your business context and ship real work in minutes.

plugins.name: ai-employee-bootcamp
plugins.description: Your complete AI employee team. One brain. Five executives. 23 skills across marketing, sales, operations, finance, content, outreach, and skill customisation, running on a schedule while you sleep. Reads your foundation documents from your Business Brain folder or GitHub repo. CMO drafts today's post in your voice. CRO builds 10 qualified prospects with personalised DM sequences powered by the Sell-by-Chat playbook. COO briefs your morning. CFO reports your revenue. Viral Hook Generator spins up 24 scroll-stopping hooks on demand. Matchmaker audits your skills against your documents. Tailor fits every skill to your exact ICP, voice, and offer. Every output is branded, animated HTML in your colors. by Daniel Paul, Purely Personal.

plugins.name: the-model-lab
plugins.description: Turn any expertise into visual selling and teaching models. The Geometry Grammar Catalogue: 12 shapes (overlap, pyramid, mountain, three roads, rings, four rooms, funnel, flywheel, iceberg, bridge, ladder, curve), each with theory, build choreography, an earning test, a self-drawing fillable worksheet with autosave, and an editable PDF. Four guided skills interview you and pre-fill everything: core-model, value-pyramid, mountain, three-roads.

plugins.name: the-stage-lab
plugins.description: Visual delivery engine for sessions and stage talks in one likeable Pixar-adjacent art direction: soft-3D characters correctly cast per role (kids, adults, animals), cinematic glows, offline single-file HTML decks. story-slides, live-visual, stage-arc, session-recap.
